timeline.summary: India Ratings and ICRA affirmed Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers' NCD ratings at AA/Stable.
India Ratings affirmed RCF's NCD rating at IND AA/Stable on 24 April 2026, with the rated amount reduced to ₹1,200 Cr from ₹1,700 Cr after a ₹500 Cr NCD was paid in full.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹5,580.57 Cr, net profit ₹186.72 Cr.

Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited’s Board, led by Executive Director Jai Bhagwan Sharma, recommended a final dividend of ₹1.34 per equity share (₹101 each) for FY2026, subject to AGM approval.
NSE and BSE levied fines of ₹5.31 lakh each on RCF for non-compliance with Regulation 17(1) board composition norms for Q4FY26.
